facts.fact: Jeanine Matthews 带人进模拟室「更新系统」，金发一丝不乱、高领蓝裙没有一个褶。
facts.anchor: Jeanine Matthews is a careful person. It shows in her smooth blond hair, not a strand out of place.

facts.fact: 她开口管他叫 Technician，不用 Dauntless 的绰号 Four。
facts.anchor: I’m sorry to intrude on your domain, Technician

facts.fact: 她把手探进模拟器的火焰后说系统里有东西被抹掉了，只留下痕迹。
facts.anchor: It seems there have been some erasures

facts.fact: 他说系统显示夜里用模拟室的人就是 Jeanine 本人，又说这不可能，把线索引向系统故障。
facts.anchor: The system told me it was you. But I know that can’t be the case.

facts.fact: Jeanine 让 Caleb 动手装更新，说正好让他练手。
facts.anchor: Have Caleb install the update. He could use the practice.

facts.fact: 到这一刻他才把门边那个蓝外套男孩认成 Tris 的哥哥。
被推进模拟室前他祈祷，别让模拟里出现 Marcus。
facts.anchor: Please don’t let it be Marcus. Please, please, please.

facts.fact: 收尾她改口叫他 Mr. Eaton，说就到这里。
